issue.body:
## Problem

The export button does nothing when the list is empty.

## Impact

Support receives one ticket a week; unknown cost.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] When the list is empty and the export button is pressed, then a message says there is nothing to export.

<details><summary>Technical analysis</summary>

Affected areas: `web` (guide: `web/AGENTS.md`)
Suspected cause: `web/src/export.ts:12`
Constraints: RULE-001
Non-binding approach: left to plan
Open questions: none

</details>

comments.body:
## Plan

### Approach A — Guard in the handler
What changes: the handler returns a message when the list is empty.
Touches: `web`: `src/export.ts`; protected: no
Slices: one PR
Honours: RULE-001
Trade-offs: + small / − the rule lives in the adapter
Risk: none noticed
Proof: new test: empty list yields the message
Effort: S

### Approach B — Disable the button
What changes: the button is disabled while the list is empty.
Touches: `web`: `src/list.ts`; protected: no
Slices: one PR
Honours: RULE-001
Trade-offs: + nothing to press / − no message
Risk: screen readers
Proof: new test: button disabled on empty list
Effort: S

### Recommendation
A.
### To decide
Reply with `approach: <letter>`.

approach: A
Amendment: keep the message under forty characters.
